items.finding: Confidential Information is defined as any non-public information disclosed by one Party to the other in connection with the Purpose, including business plans, client names and project details, pricing, source code, technical designs, and (in the case of Mr. Ortiz) his rates and proprietary tools. This definition is mutual in substance as it applies to both AtliQ and Mr. Ortiz's information.
items.quote: 2.1 **Confidential Information** means any non-public information disclosed by one Party (the **Disclosing Party** ) to the other (the **Receiving Party** ) in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked or identified as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential, including business plans, client names and project details, pricing, source code, technical designs, and (in the case of Mr. Ortiz) his rates and proprietary tools. **Confidential Information** does not include information that the Receiving Party can show (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is lawfully received from a third party without restriction; or (d) is independently developed without use of the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

items.finding: Both AtliQ and Mr. Ortiz are bound by the obligations to use the Confidential Information only for the Purpose and not to disclose it to any third party except under specific conditions. The obligations are mutual in substance.
items.quote: 3.1 The Receiving Party shall (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) not disclose it to any third party except, in AtliQ's case, to its Affiliates, employees and professional advisers with a need to know who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement; and (c) protect it with at least reasonable care.

items.finding: There are no explicit rights retained by either party to use the Confidential Information after the term of the agreement. The obligations in Sections 3 and 4 continue for three (3) years after the end of the two-year disclosure period, but no license is granted except as expressly stated.
items.quote: 6.1 Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party, and no license is granted except as expressly stated. **5.1 This Agreement applies to information disclosed during the two (2) years following the Effective Date. The obligations in Sections 3 and 4 continue for three (3) years after the end of that period.**

items.finding: Both parties have the right to seek injunctive relief for any actual or threatened breach of this Agreement. The remedies are mutual in substance.
items.quote: 7.1 Each Party may seek injunctive relief for any actual or threatened breach of this Agreement, in addition to any other remedy.

items.finding: There are no non-compete, non-solicit, or exclusivity covenants hidden in the NDA. The obligations are limited to the use and protection of Confidential Information.
items.quote: 3.1 The Receiving Party shall (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) not disclose it to any third party except, in AtliQ's case, to its Affiliates, employees and professional advisers with a need to know who are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement; and (c) protect it with at least reasonable care. **8.2 This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.**

items.finding: The term of the NDA is fixed and covers the two-year disclosure period and an additional three-year period for the obligations in Sections 3 and 4. The obligations survive the term of the agreement.
items.quote: 5.1 This Agreement applies to information disclosed during the two (2) years following the Effective Date. The obligations in Sections 3 and 4 continue for three (3) years after the end of that period.
